commits.author: opencode-agent[bot]
commits.message:
Migrate sample-app-netflix-dgs from DGS to spring-boot-starter-graphql for Spring Boot 4.x compatibility

Netflix DGS 9.x is incompatible with Spring Boot 4.x (references
JacksonAutoConfiguration which no longer exists). DGS 11.x/12.x which
supports Spring Boot 4.x is not yet published to Maven Central.

Changes:
- Replace graphql-dgs-spring-boot-starter with spring-boot-starter-graphql
  and spring-graphql-test
- Migrate @DgsComponent + @DgsData to @Controller + @QueryMapping/@MutationMapping
- Remove DGS-specific EmployeeContext and EmployeeContextBuilder
- Change int -> Integer for salary/age fields in Employee and EmployeeInput
- Move GraphQL schemas from resources/schema/ to resources/graphql/
- Update schemas: QueryResolver/MutationResolver -> Query/Mutation types
- Rewrite tests using ExecutionGraphQlServiceTester instead of DgsQueryExecutor

All 9 tests pass.

commits.author: opencode-agent[bot]
commits.message:
Fix tests for Spring Boot 4.x compatibility

- sample-app-spring-graphql: Replace removed @AutoConfigureGraphQlTester with
  ExecutionGraphQlServiceTester; fix primitive int fields in Employee to Integer
  to allow null in partial GraphQL responses; update java.version to 17

- sample-app-kickstart: Migrate from incompatible graphql-java-kickstart (uses
  Jackson 2.x, incompatible with Spring Boot 4.x Jackson 3.x) to
  spring-boot-starter-graphql; convert resolvers from GraphQLQueryResolver/
  GraphQLMutationResolver pattern to Spring @Controller with @QueryMapping/
  @MutationMapping; update GraphQL schemas to use standard Query/Mutation types;
  rewrite tests using ExecutionGraphQlServiceTester; fix primitive int fields in
  Employee to Integer
